newsitem.title: GERMANY: German electrical industry sees 2-3 pct '97 growth.
newsitem.headline: German electrical industry sees 2-3 pct '97 growth.

text.p: The German electrical industry trade association (ZVEI) said on Tuesday that it expected production and sales in the industry to grow by between two and three percent in 1997.
Production grew by more than two percent in the first two months of 1997, ZWEI head Volker Jung told a news conference in Frankfurt.
But the industry also warned that some further jobs would be cut in the sector this year, after 42,000 job cuts last year which took the total employed in the sector to 866,000.
World-wide sales in 1996 in the sector grew 4.1 percent to 231 billion marks, the ZVEI said.
